 Function: Sales / Business Development Segment: Startups & Digital Native Businesses Reporting Line: CBO / Practice Head Location: Mumbai / Bangalore Experience: 2-5 years Career Path: This role has a clear path to a leadership position within the Startup segment, based on performance and demonstrated character. 
 ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a driven, ecosystem savvy sales professional to own and grow our Startup segment business. This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data & AI, and the AWS partner ecosystem, working directly with founders and CTOs to help fast growing startups adopt cloud and AI capabilities, while maximizing the commercial and funding levers available through AWS. This is an end to end ownership role: from sourcing and qualifying opportunities within the AWS ecosystem, to closing deals, to ensuring startups are set up for long term success on the platform. High performers in this role will be given the opportunity to step into a segment leadership position. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Own the Startup Sales Motion End to End Own the complete sales cycle: discovery, qualification, solutioning, proposal development, commercial negotiation, and deal closure. Manage opportunities sourced through AWS referrals, marketing generated leads, inbound inquiries, outbound prospecting, and startup ecosystem partnerships. Maintain accurate pipeline visibility and forecasting. AWS Partner Ecosystem & Program Execution Build and manage the AWS partner ecosystem relationship, working closely with AWS Startup AMs and PSMs to source leads, co sell, and align on account strategy. Structure and execute large PPA and MAP engagements, managing commercial and technical stakeholders through to signature. Leverage AWS funding and enablement programs, including AWS Activate, MAP, Well-Architected Reviews, GenAI-specific programs, and other funding initiatives, to structure well funded, compelling deals for startup customers. Represent the company at AWS and startup ecosystem events, building a personal network of founders, investors, and AWS ecosystem stakeholders. Consultative Selling to Founders & CTOs Engage directly with Founders, CTOs, and technical decision makers, understanding their business and technical priorities. Maintain a strong working understanding of the Data & AI landscape, including relevant AWS services, competitive tooling, and startup buying patterns, to have credible, consultative conversations. Articulate business value, ROI, scalability, and operational benefits, not just technical fit. Startup Ecosystem Development Build and maintain relationships beyond the immediate buyer, including accelerators, incubators, venture capital firms, and startup communities. Build ecosystem driven lead generation channels and create long term strategic relationships within the startup ecosystem. Account Growth & Expansion Drive new logo acquisition within the startup segment. Identify upsell and cross sell opportunities within existing accounts as they scale (migration, modernization, managed services, data & AI, security). Develop long term account growth strategies rather than treating deals as one off transactions. Cross Functional Collaboration Work closely with Marketing, Presales, Delivery, and various AWS teams to ensure deals are well solutioned and well supported post sale. Provide market intelligence and customer feedback to help refine messaging, offerings, and GTM strategy for the startup segment. Contribute to startup focused sales playbooks and best practices. 
 MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS Proven experience working within the AWS partner ecosystem. Demonstrated experience engaging with Founders and CTOs as primary buyers/stakeholders. Strong working understanding of the Data & AI landscape (platforms, tooling, and buyer priorities). Track record of owning and driving deals end to end, with full accountability for closure. Hands on experience executing large PPAs and MAPs. Deep, working understanding of AWS funding programs. Direct experience working with AWS Startup AM/BD/CSR/DGs and PSMs. AWS certifications (e.g. Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect Associate). 
 GOOD TO HAVE Proficiency with APN (AWS Partner Network) portals and AWS funding/co sell portals. Prior experience at a cloud consulting/reseller partner, systems integrator, or a startup focused GTM function. Existing network within startup, VC, accelerator, or founder communities. 
 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Entrepreneurial mindset with a genuine interest in the startup ecosystem. Hunter mentality paired with an ability to grow and expand existing accounts. Ability to simplify complex technology into clear business outcomes. High ownership, urgency, and ability to operate independently. Curiosity, resilience, and a continuous learning mindset. 
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Consistent, predictable pipeline generation and conversion within the startup segment. Well structured, funded deals that maximize both customer value and AWS program benefits. Strong, trusted relationships with AWS AMs/PSMs that translate into reliable deal flow. Growth of AWS sourced and ecosystem driven opportunities over time. Strong pipeline hygiene and forecasting accuracy. Demonstrated readiness to take on broader leadership responsibility for the segment. 
 GROWTH PATH This role is structured as a growth seat. Based on performance and the character displayed in how deals, relationships, and the team are handled, the successful candidate will be positioned to take on leadership of the Startup segment.

Support vulnerability management, policy enforcement, secrets management, and certificate management capabilities.  Collaboration Technical Leadership

title: Sr Principal - Cloud Platform Engineer - Cloud Native
description:
Job Summary 
 The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - Cloud Native builds and runs automation scripts and tools (IaC / Terraform) to streamline provisioning, configuration, and management of Cloud PaaS and Serverless Services, and sets the engineering standard within those services, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering Operations. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform teams availability. Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. Work the platforms manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 
 
 Educational Background 
 Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 
 
 Area of Specialisation 
 Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 
 
 Experience Required 
 Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. Deep hands-on depth in Cloud PaaS and Serverless Technologies across Azure, Azure Local and GCP Proficient in writing scripts using Terraform, Python, Ansible, Json and PowerShell Experience with building, configuring and managing Cloud AI Services (e.g. Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Google Document AI, BigQuery AI) Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. Strong expertise in Azure/GCP application services (e.g. Logic Apps, Function Apps, App Services, cloud run, pub/sub) for designing and implementing scalable, secure, and cloud-native solutions. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform. Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 
 
 Desirable 
 Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS GKE Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc. Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices 
 
 Skills/Background 
 Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. 
 
 Skills 
 Terraform Python Ansible Kubernetes Docker Azure GCP CI/CD Observability

title: PMIC Systems and Validation Engineer, Senior
description:
Company: Qualcomm India Private Limited Job Area: Engineering Group, Hardware Engineering 

 Job Summary 
 As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements. 

 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. OR Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 1+ year of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. OR PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field. 

 Responsibilities 
 This job involves a mix of Architecture, HW Systems, Functional Validation, Chipset integration customer issue debug support. We are looking for Systems Validation engineers with preferably 3 - 5 years of experience in analog/power electronics. Depending on your experience level and area of technical expertise you will own and participate in systems definition, HW/SW debugging and validation of PMIC solutions by partnering with various engineering teams like Analog/Digital Design, Software and Customer Engineering in a fast-paced environment. Systems involves coming up with a Top-Level specification (involving HW/FW/SW level partitioning of feature-design, HW Register interfaces, memory sizing, protocol selection, multi-PMIC connectivity grid, debug framework support, etc) to satisfy all chipset level requirements. Validation involves coming up with a comprehensive functional validation plan (that covers both manual and scripted automated test cases), executing them within stipulated time-period, analyzing results at HW-level (via signal measurements), debugging issues creating reports. Engineers will be responsible to perform risk assessment of development and validation plans; and interact with PMIC Product Management, Design Characterization teams; other SoC HW/SW Architecture, Development Validation teams; and finally Customer-Engagement teams across worldwide sites. 

 Education Requirements 
 A Bachelor's degree in Electronics related Engineering is a must. Masters degree is preferred esp. with specialization in VLSI / Microelectronics, Power Management, etc. 

 Minimum Qualifications 
 3 - 5 years of job-experience relevant to various HW/S aspects of any electronic product development. They should be well-versed with knowledge of entire ASIC Flow (from concept-stage to commercial-product support). 

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Applicants should be aware of fundamentals of PMIC, Power Management, Microcontroller architecture, basic-firmware HW-SW interaction. Applicants should also have strong hands-on lab-experience in Post-Si Validation. (HW-level Bench measurement and/or SW-level logs-based verification). Preferred Skills: Hands-on ability comfort in using various lab instruments like oscilloscopes, power supplies, JTAG debuggers etc. Good understanding of PMIC, Power Electronics , digital embedded electronics concepts Good Hardware Debug Skills related to DC -DC (SMPS, LDO) converters preferred. Good programming skills in at least one of the following: C#, F#, Python, Perl, LabVIEW or any other scripting language (used in VLSI/Embedded Domain) + understanding of few OOPS concepts. Familiarity with HW schematics and ability to trace inter connections on a PCB. Good analytical communication (verbal/written) skills. Ability to seek information pro-actively, understand priorities and juggle multiple tasks in a highly paced environment. Experience in automating test-cases via SW-control for HW-systems Ability to come up with a High-Level Strategy for any objective and being able to break it into Mid-level flows Low-level tasks for efficient execution. Prior experience in leading executing white-box validation efforts of a HW-module or sub-module, is a big plus. Exposure to Assembly-language programming (for microcontroller) is good-to-have. Exposure to tools like JIRA and GIT are a plus. 

 Keywords 
 PMIC, Power Systems, System Architecture, switch mode power supply, SMPS, DC-DC, LDO, ADC, functional Validation, test automation, Voltage Regulators, Battery Chargers, Battery Management/Gauging

A regular in Fortune 500 list, Elevance Health ranked 18 in 2026. Gail Boudreaux , President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 81st rank on this list. ABOUT CARELON GLOBAL SOLUTIONS Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system. Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers. Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity JOB PURPOSE Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking a Senior Manager Architecture to lead architecture and end-to-end implementation of enterprise pharmacy management capabilities for CarelonRx. The role owns technical vision, solution architecture, engineering execution, implementation readiness, and platform outcomes across complex, multi-system pharmacy transformation programs. The position is intentionally weighted toward architecture, engineering, AI-enabled Spec-Driven Development, and large-scale implementation leadership. Delivery administration is a supporting responsibility, not the primary mandate. The leader will combine strong software engineering depth with practical pharmacy and PBM domain knowledge to translate business capabilities into secure, scalable, resilient, and operable platforms. JOB RESPONSIBILITY Enterprise Pharmacy Architecture Define and govern target-state solution architecture for end-to-end pharmacy management systems, aligned with enterprise architecture, security, data, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory guardrails. Create capability maps, domain boundaries, reference architectures, reusable patterns, integration standards, and modernization roadmaps across the pharmacy ecosystem. Lead architecture decisions for microservices, APIs, event streaming, workflow orchestration, data platforms, cloud-native services, observability, and interoperability with legacy platforms. Own architecture reviews, trade-off decisions, non-functional requirements, technical debt strategy, and design assurance from concept through production adoption. End-To-End Pharmacy Platform Implementation Lead implementation across relevant pharmacy and PBM capabilities such as benefit configuration, formulary, eligibility, claims adjudication, pricing, prior authorization, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, rebates, member and provider experiences, and operational reporting. Translate business journeys and pharmacy operating models into domain-aligned services, data contracts, interfaces, implementation increments, migration plans, and measurable acceptance criteria. Own the technical implementation lifecycle covering discovery, architecture, engineering, integration, data conversion, testing strategy, cutover, production readiness, stabilization, and benefits realization. Manage cross-platform dependencies and ensure that application, data, infrastructure, security, operations, and vendor workstreams converge into one implementable solution. Drive phased rollout, coexistence, migration, and decommissioning strategies that protect member, client, pharmacy, and operational continuity. AI-Enabled Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Establish an AI-first Spec-Driven Development approach in which approved business, architecture, interface, security, testing, and operational specifications become the governed source for implementation. Enable engineering agents and copilots to accelerate design elaboration, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, traceability, and impact analysis, with human review and approval at critical control points. Define reusable SDD templates, prompt and context standards, repository conventions, quality gates, evaluation criteria, and responsible AI controls for enterprise adoption. Measure SDD outcomes using baselines and agreed targets for engineering cycle time, specification-to-code traceability, automated test coverage, escaped defects, rework, deployment frequency, and productivity improvement. Ensure AI-generated artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, explainability, maintainability, and auditability. Engineering Excellence And Hands-On Technical Leadership Provide credible, hands-on technical leadership through design reviews, code and API reviews, proof-of-concept direction, critical problem solving, performance analysis, and production diagnostics. Guide teams on software design principles, domain-driven design, secure coding, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, reliability engineering, and cloud cost optimization. Define engineering scorecards and quality gates covering code health, architecture compliance, security vulnerabilities, reliability, performance, recoverability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Champion platform engineering, reusable services, developer experience, automated environments, and self-service capabilities that reduce implementation friction at scale. Large-Scale Implementation Leadership Lead multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams across product, architecture, software engineering, data, quality engineering, cloud, security, operations, and partner organizations. Create an integrated technical implementation plan that connects architecture runway, dependency sequencing, environment readiness, test strategy, migration, cutover, and operational acceptance. Act as the senior technical decision-maker for complex implementation risks, cross-team conflicts, architecture exceptions, integration failures, and production-readiness gaps. Provide transparent executive-level reporting on architecture health, implementation progress, critical dependencies, risk exposure, quality, readiness, and realized business outcomes. Build governance that is lightweight but effective, emphasizing decision velocity, measurable technical outcomes, and removal of systemic blockers rather than delivery administration. Pharmacy Domain And Stakeholder Partnership Apply working knowledge of the prescription lifecycle, PBM operations, payer and pharmacy interactions, clinical and utilization management, drug data, pricing, formulary, claims, and applicable industry transactions and regulations. Partner with pharmacy business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, security, operations, compliance, and client teams to shape solutions that are technically sound and operationally adoptable. Convert domain policies, rules, and exceptions into explicit specifications, testable requirements, decision services, and traceable implementation controls. Challenge assumptions using outside-in engineering and pharmacy-platform practices while tailoring recommendations to CarelonRx business priorities and enterprise constraints. People And Capability Leadership Build, lead, and mentor engineering managers, solution architects, principal engineers, technical leads, developers, quality engineers, and platform specialists across distributed teams. Establish clear technical accountabilities, architecture ownership, engineering career paths, succession plans, and communities of practice for pharmacy engineering and AI SDD. Create a culture of engineering rigor, transparent decision-making, experimentation, learning, inclusion, and accountability for outcomes. Assess capability gaps and execute hiring, upskilling, partner augmentation, and workforce plans required for large-scale implementation. Delivery Governance As A Supporting Responsibility Partner with product and program leadership on planning, investment sequencing, release readiness, dependency management, and risk escalation. Use delivery metrics only as supporting indicators. Primary accountability remains architecture quality, end-to-end implementation integrity, engineering excellence, and business capability outcomes. Ensure commitments are realistic, technically grounded, and supported by clear specifications, measurable acceptance criteria, and production-readiness evidence. QUALIFICATION Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred. Strong foundation in software engineering, enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, cloud engineering, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational resilience. Demonstrated ability to communicate architecture and implementation choices to business executives, product leaders, engineers, risk partners, and external vendors. Ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based trade-offs, and connect pharmacy business outcomes to technical architecture and implementation decisions. Working knowledge of Agile, product operating models, DevSecOps, secure SDLC, and modern engineering governance. EXPERIENCE 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology implementation, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, architects, or large technical teams. Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-year enterprise implementations involving multiple applications, complex integrations, data migration, cloud platforms, distributed teams, and production cutover. Relevant healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM experience, with demonstrable understanding of end-to-end pharmacy capabilities and their technology implications. Demonstrated experience defining target architecture and taking complex platforms from architecture through implementation, production readiness, stabilization, and measurable adoption. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering, Spec-Driven Development, agentic workflows, or comparable automation across the SDLC with appropriate human oversight and governance. Experience managing strategic vendors and globally distributed teams while retaining internal ownership of architecture, engineering quality, and implementation outcomes. Experience modernizing legacy systems using APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, cloud-native platforms, automated testing, DevSecOps, observability, and reliability practices. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES Core Technical Competencies Enterprise and solution architecture; domain-driven design; capability modeling; microservices; API-first and event-driven architecture; integration and interoperability patterns. Java and/or .NET engineering ecosystems; REST and GraphQL APIs; event-streaming platforms; containers and Kubernetes; Azure and/or AWS; CI/CD; infrastructure as code; observability and SRE practices. Data architecture, master and reference data, transactional and analytical data patterns, data quality, lineage, privacy, and secure information exchange. Architecture fitness functions, performance engineering, resilience, disaster recovery, security-by-design, threat modeling, and production operability. Pharmacy And Healthcare Domain Competencies Prescription and pharmacy claims lifecycle; benefit configuration; formulary and utilization management; eligibility; pricing; pharmacy networks; specialty and mail pharmacy; clinical programs; rebates; member and provider journeys. Awareness of healthcare and pharmacy interoperability, transaction standards, regulatory obligations, data privacy, and audit requirements relevant to the assigned platform scope. AI and SDD Competencies Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted software engineering, agent orchestration, retrieval and context patterns, prompt and evaluation practices, automated testing, traceability, and responsible AI governance. Ability to establish engineering baselines, controlled pilots, adoption guardrails, and measurable value realization for AI-enabled development. Leadership Competencies Strategic thinking, systems thinking, executive communication, architecture decision-making, technical talent development, vendor leadership, influencing without authority, and crisis leadership. Bias for simplification, measurable outcomes, engineering quality, operational accountability, and continuous improvement. Preferred Certifications Cloud architecture certification in Azure or AWS. AI, machine learning, responsible AI, or generative AI certification. Healthcare or pharmacy domain certification, where applicable. SAFe Agilist or equivalent product and Agile leadership certification. Indicative Success Measures Architecture: target-state adoption, design conformance, reuse, technical debt reduction, resilience, security, and platform scalability.  About the Role 
 Configure, manage, monitor, and optimize enterprise storage, backup, archival, recovery, and data protection platforms. Support storage services across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments with a focus on availability, performance, security, and scalability. Troubleshoot complex storage, connectivity, backup, recovery, and performance issues in partnership with server engineers, database administrators, application owners, network engineers, security teams, and cloud engineering teams. Programming, scripting, and automation experience using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Go, YAML, and Ansible. Experience developing APIs and automation for storage resource management, including self-service provisioning, platform upgrades, object-storage buckets, volumes, and file shares. Experience implementing storage solutions that align with security requirements, data protection standards, and cloud security best practices. Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to collaborate across server, database, application, network, security, and cloud engineering teams. Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and work flexible hours as required.

Experience with enterprise storage and virtualization platforms such as NetApp FAS and ONTAP, Dell EMC Isilon/PowerScale and Unity, IBM FlashSystem 7300, and VMware ESXi 7.x/8.x. Experience working in a global technology environment with distributed teams and business-critical systems.

You’ll collaborate with talented technology teams, gain exposure to modern storage, cloud, DevOps, automation, and Kubernetes practices, and contribute to high-impact infrastructure modernization. You’ll be part of a culture that values ownership, continuous improvement, operational excellence, and bold thinking.

As a core part of Rocket’s global ecosystem, Rocket India builds scalable technology platforms and digital solutions that simplify mortgage origination and servicing.  Security Architecture, Solution Design & Assurance - Act as the security architecture lead for AI, GenAI, and cloud transformation initiatives. - Review and approve solution architectures to ensure alignment with enterprise security standards, policies, and regulatory requirements. - Provide security design guidance throughout the solution lifecycle, from concept and architecture to implementation and operations. - Conduct architecture risk assessments and identify security gaps, design weaknesses, and mitigation strategies. - Develop and maintain reference architectures, security patterns, and reusable design frameworks for AI and cloud platforms. - Participate in Architecture Review Boards (ARB), technical design reviews, and governance forums. - Evaluate emerging AI technologies, cloud services, and platforms to determine security implications and architectural suitability. - Ensure Security-by-Design and Privacy-by Design principles are embedded within AI and cloud solutions. - Define security requirements for integrations, APIs, data flows, and third-party services. - Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Engineering, Data Engineering, and Application Development teams to establish secure and scalable solutions. - Perform security assurance reviews prior to production deployment and provide risk-based recommendations. - Support threat modeling, attack surface analysis, and architecture assessments for strategic business initiatives. 
 Cloud Security & Infrastructure Protection - Design and implement security controls across Azure, AWS, and GCP environments supporting AI workloads. - Secure cloud-native AI services, machine learning platforms, data lakes, and AI development environments. - Ensure cloud architectures comply with enterprise security standards and industry best practices. - Implement Zero Trust Architecture principles across AI and cloud workloads. - Integrate AI security requirements into cloud security frameworks, operating models, and engineering practices. 
 Data Security & Privacy - Define and implement controls to protect sensitive, regulated, and business-critical data utilized by AI systems. - Ensure data classification, encryption, tokenization, masking, and privacy-preserving controls are implemented and maintained. - Monitor and prevent data leakage through AI applications, APIs, and cloud services. - Establish secure data-sharing, retention, and lifecycle management practices. - Ensure compliance with applicable data privacy regulations and organizational data protection policies. Identity & Access Management - Design and implement Identity and Access Management (IAM) controls for AI platforms and cloud services. - Enforce least-privilege access, Privileged Access Management (PAM), and strong authentication controls. - Review access governance processes and ensure secure integration with enterprise identity platforms. 
 Security Operations & Threat Management - Develop monitoring, detection, and response use cases for AI-specific threats, including prompt injection, model poisoning, adversarial attacks, data leakage, and unauthorized model access. - Collaborate with SOC, Incident Response, and Threat Intelligence teams to investigate and respond to AI-related security incidents. - Conduct vulnerability assessments, architecture reviews, and security testing activities for AI applications and supporting infrastructure. - Support continuous monitoring and ongoing improvement of AI security controls and capabilities.

Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles, security frameworks, regulatory controls, risk management, and architecture governance. Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, facilitation and technical documentation skills.
